subject: time-of-day control
outcome: An interactive sunlight slider drives directional lighting and casts shadows, with neutral fill lighting and a stable scene state.
acceptanceCriteriaReviewed: Provide usable lighting controls and directional shadows
Keep light simulation distinct from claims about historically exact conditions
validation: Architecture unit checks and rendered Chromium desktop/mobile review; relevant scene behavior inspected in source and QA captures.
limits: Simulated illumination does not claim fifth-century weather or exact historical solar setting.

review.note: Deliverable is implemented in independently authored project code and checked against recorded public evidence and browser tests.
